title: 2x Runner Bean 'Lady Di' Plug Plants – Stringless, Long Pods
description:
Grow your own delicious runner beans with these  2 healthy plug plants  of the highly regarded  Runner Bean 'Lady Di'  
     
Key Features:      
Outstanding Quality  : Produces long, uniform pods up to 30cm, with excellent texture and taste.    
Stringless  : Enjoy tender beans with no tough strings.    
Attractive Red Flowers  : Adds a splash of colour to your veg patch or border.    
Heavy Cropping  : Pick regularly for a continuous harvest all summer.    
Growing Instructions:    Plant in rich, well-prepared soil with plenty of organic matter.   
Provide sturdy supports (canes, wires, or netting) for climbing.  
Keep well-watered, especially while flowers are setting.   Protect young plants from pests.
